5th Grade · Theme 1 · School Life

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Mert's school has a leader. He manages the school and talks to teachers. He is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) headmaster

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert's school has a leader. He manages the school and talks to teachers.” Bu tarif “headmaster” kelimesine uyar; headmaster = okul müdürü. Diğer şıklar: secretary (sekreter), English teacher (İngilizce öğretmeni), student (öğrenci).

2

Ece feels ill at school. A woman checks her temperature and helps her. This woman is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) school nurse

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece feels ill at school. A woman checks her temperature and helps her.” Bu tarif “school nurse” kelimesine uyar; school nurse = okul hemşiresi. Diğer şıklar: classmate (sınıf arkadaşı), canteen worker (kantin görevlisi), science teacher (fen bilimleri öğretmeni).

3

Ali sees a worker in the corridor. This person cleans the floors every day. He is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) cleaner

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali sees a worker in the corridor. This person cleans the floors every day.” Bu tarif “cleaner” kelimesine uyar; cleaner = temizlik görevlisi. Diğer şıklar: English teacher (İngilizce öğretmeni), headmaster (okul müdürü), student (öğrenci).

4

Our football team meets after school. One person teaches us how to play well. This person is our ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) coach

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Our football team meets after school. One person teaches us how to play well.” Bu tarif “coach” kelimesine uyar; coach = antrenör. Diğer şıklar: science teacher (fen bilimleri öğretmeni), canteen worker (kantin görevlisi), school nurse (okul hemşiresi).

5

Elif visits the school office. A woman answers calls and writes notes for the headmaster. She is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) secretary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif visits the school office. A woman answers calls and writes notes for the headmaster.” Bu tarif “secretary” kelimesine uyar; secretary = sekreter. Diğer şıklar: cleaner (temizlik görevlisi), student (öğrenci), headmaster (okul müdürü).

6

Sena and I are students in the same class. We have our lessons together. Sena is my ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) classmate

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena and I are students in the same class. We have our lessons together.” Bu tarif “classmate” kelimesine uyar; classmate = sınıf arkadaşı. Diğer şıklar: coach (antrenör), school nurse (okul hemşiresi), English teacher (İngilizce öğretmeni).

7

Bora learns about plants and animals. His teacher explains experiments in the lab. This person is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) science teacher

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora learns about plants and animals. His teacher explains experiments in the lab.” Bu tarif “science teacher” kelimesine uyar; science teacher = fen bilimleri öğretmeni. Diğer şıklar: cleaner (temizlik görevlisi), secretary (sekreter), student (öğrenci).

8

Duru buys a sandwich at school. A man sells food and drinks during the break. He is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) canteen worker

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru buys a sandwich at school. A man sells food and drinks during the break.” Bu tarif “canteen worker” kelimesine uyar; canteen worker = kantin görevlisi. Diğer şıklar: coach (antrenör), classmate (sınıf arkadaşı), school nurse (okul hemşiresi).

9

Arda learns words such as apple and pencil. A woman teaches him to speak English. She is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) English teacher

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda learns words such as apple and pencil. A woman teaches him to speak English.” Bu tarif “English teacher” kelimesine uyar; English teacher = İngilizce öğretmeni. Diğer şıklar: science teacher (fen bilimleri öğretmeni), secretary (sekreter), cleaner (temizlik görevlisi).

10

Can goes to school every weekday. He learns new things and does homework. He is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) student

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can goes to school every weekday. He learns new things and does homework.” Bu tarif “student” kelimesine uyar; student = öğrenci. Diğer şıklar: classmate (sınıf arkadaşı), canteen worker (kantin görevlisi), coach (antrenör).

11

İpek wants a book to read. She visits a quiet room with many books. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) library

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek wants a book to read. She visits a quiet room with many books.” Bu tarif “library” kelimesine uyar; library = kütüphane. Diğer şıklar: conference hall (konferans salonu), sports field (spor sahası), canteen (kantin).

12

Eren enjoys experiments. He uses special equipment with his science teacher. Their room is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) science lab

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren enjoys experiments. He uses special equipment with his science teacher.” Bu tarif “science lab” kelimesine uyar; science lab = fen laboratuvarı. Diğer şıklar: playground (oyun alanı), corridor (koridor), noticeboard (duyuru panosu).

13

Melis learns to use a keyboard and a mouse. Each student uses a computer in this room. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) computer room

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis learns to use a keyboard and a mouse. Each student uses a computer in this room.” Bu tarif “computer room” kelimesine uyar; computer room = bilgisayar sınıfı. Diğer şıklar: conference hall (konferans salonu), canteen (kantin), library (kütüphane).

14

Teachers have a room at our school. They rest and talk there between lessons. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) staff room

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Teachers have a room at our school. They rest and talk there between lessons.” Bu tarif “staff room” kelimesine uyar; staff room = öğretmenler odası. Diğer şıklar: science lab (fen laboratuvarı), sports field (spor sahası), corridor (koridor).

15

Children play games outside at break time. They have a safe place for these games. This place is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) playground

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Children play games outside at break time. They have a safe place for these games.” Bu tarif “playground” kelimesine uyar; playground = oyun alanı. Diğer şıklar: computer room (bilgisayar sınıfı), noticeboard (duyuru panosu), conference hall (konferans salonu).

16

Kerem is hungry at break time. He goes to a place at school to buy a snack. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) canteen

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem is hungry at break time. He goes to a place at school to buy a snack.” Bu tarif “canteen” kelimesine uyar; canteen = kantin. Diğer şıklar: staff room (öğretmenler odası), library (kütüphane), sports field (spor sahası).

17

Classroom doors open into a long indoor passage. Students walk through it between rooms. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) corridor

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Classroom doors open into a long indoor passage. Students walk through it between rooms.” Bu tarif “corridor” kelimesine uyar; corridor = koridor. Diğer şıklar: playground (oyun alanı), science lab (fen laboratuvarı), computer room (bilgisayar sınıfı).

18

The school puts club announcements on a large board. Defne reads the new notices there. This board is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) noticeboard

Paragraftaki ipucu: “The school puts club announcements on a large board. Defne reads the new notices there.” Bu tarif “noticeboard” kelimesine uyar; noticeboard = duyuru panosu. Diğer şıklar: staff room (öğretmenler odası), library (kütüphane), canteen (kantin).

19

Many parents visit our school for a talk. They sit in a large room and listen to the speaker. This room is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) conference hall

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Many parents visit our school for a talk. They sit in a large room and listen to the speaker.” Bu tarif “conference hall” kelimesine uyar; conference hall = konferans salonu. Diğer şıklar: science lab (fen laboratuvarı), corridor (koridor), playground (oyun alanı).

20

Our team plays football outdoors. There are goals at both ends of this school area. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) sports field

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Our team plays football outdoors. There are goals at both ends of this school area.” Bu tarif “sports field” kelimesine uyar; sports field = spor sahası. Diğer şıklar: noticeboard (duyuru panosu), computer room (bilgisayar sınıfı), staff room (öğretmenler odası).

21

Zeynep loves colours and pictures. She joins a club to draw and paint after school. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) art club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep loves colours and pictures. She joins a club to draw and paint after school.” Bu tarif “art club” kelimesine uyar; art club = resim kulübü. Diğer şıklar: maths club (matematik kulübü), film club (film kulübü), folk dance club (halk oyunları kulübü).

22

Emir enjoys a board game with black and white pieces. He moves kings and queens with his friends. He belongs to the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) chess club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir enjoys a board game with black and white pieces. He moves kings and queens with his friends.” Bu tarif “chess club” kelimesine uyar; chess club = satranç kulübü. Diğer şıklar: environment club (çevre kulübü), technology club (teknoloji kulübü), ballet club (bale kulübü).

23

Aslı loves singing and playing the guitar. She practises songs with a group after lessons. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) music club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aslı loves singing and playing the guitar. She practises songs with a group after lessons.” Bu tarif “music club” kelimesine uyar; music club = müzik kulübü. Diğer şıklar: film club (film kulübü), folk dance club (halk oyunları kulübü), maths club (matematik kulübü).

24

Baran enjoys acting on a stage. His group practises a play every week. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) drama club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran enjoys acting on a stage. His group practises a play every week.” Bu tarif “drama club” kelimesine uyar; drama club = tiyatro kulübü. Diğer şıklar: technology club (teknoloji kulübü), chess club (satranç kulübü), art club (resim kulübü).

25

Nehir wants a cleaner planet. Her group collects litter and protects nature. She joins the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) environment club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir wants a cleaner planet. Her group collects litter and protects nature.” Bu tarif “environment club” kelimesine uyar; environment club = çevre kulübü. Diğer şıklar: ballet club (bale kulübü), music club (müzik kulübü), film club (film kulübü).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ozan loves traditional dances. His group learns dances from different parts of Türkiye. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) folk dance club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan loves traditional dances. His group learns dances from different parts of Türkiye.” Bu tarif “folk dance club” kelimesine uyar; folk dance club = halk oyunları kulübü. Diğer şıklar: chess club (satranç kulübü), drama club (tiyatro kulübü), music club (müzik kulübü).

2

Selin enjoys dancing on a stage. She practises ballet steps after school. She goes to the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) ballet club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin enjoys dancing on a stage. She practises ballet steps after school.” Bu tarif “ballet club” kelimesine uyar; ballet club = bale kulübü. Diğer şıklar: environment club (çevre kulübü), art club (resim kulübü), technology club (teknoloji kulübü).

3

Tuna enjoys numbers and difficult problems. His group solves number puzzles together. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) maths club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna enjoys numbers and difficult problems. His group solves number puzzles together.” Bu tarif “maths club” kelimesine uyar; maths club = matematik kulübü. Diğer şıklar: drama club (tiyatro kulübü), chess club (satranç kulübü), music club (müzik kulübü).

4

Eylül enjoys watching films. Her group watches a film and talks about its story. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) film club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül enjoys watching films. Her group watches a film and talks about its story.” Bu tarif “film club” kelimesine uyar; film club = film kulübü. Diğer şıklar: folk dance club (halk oyunları kulübü), ballet club (bale kulübü), environment club (çevre kulübü).

5

Yiğit likes building simple robots. His group learns about new devices and how they work. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) technology club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yiğit likes building simple robots. His group learns about new devices and how they work.” Bu tarif “technology club” kelimesine uyar; technology club = teknoloji kulübü. Diğer şıklar: art club (resim kulübü), maths club (matematik kulübü), drama club (tiyatro kulübü).

6

The teacher wants everyone to stop talking. The class needs silence for a listening activity. The teacher says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) Be quiet

Paragraftaki ipucu: “The teacher wants everyone to stop talking. The class needs silence for a listening activity.” Bu tarif “Be quiet” kelimesine uyar; Be quiet = Sessiz ol. Diğer şıklar: Don't shout (Bağırma), Don't be rude (Kaba olma), Wear your uniform (Üniformanı giy).

7

Our lesson starts now. The teacher wants us to look at page ten in our books. She says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) Open your book

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Our lesson starts now. The teacher wants us to look at page ten in our books.” Bu tarif “Open your book” kelimesine uyar; Open your book = Kitabını aç. Diğer şıklar: Don't be late (Geç kalma), Obey the rules (Kurallara uy), Be kind (Kibar ol).

8

The classroom door is open. Noise comes in from the corridor. The teacher says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Close the door

Paragraftaki ipucu: “The classroom door is open. Noise comes in from the corridor.” Bu tarif “Close the door” kelimesine uyar; Close the door = Kapıyı kapat. Diğer şıklar: Don't eat in the classroom (Sınıfta yemek yeme), Don't be rude (Kaba olma), Be quiet (Sessiz ol).

9

Our school has special clothes for students. We need these clothes every school day. The school rule says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) Wear your uniform

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Our school has special clothes for students. We need these clothes every school day.” Bu tarif “Wear your uniform” kelimesine uyar; Wear your uniform = Üniformanı giy. Diğer şıklar: Be kind (Kibar ol), Obey the rules (Kurallara uy), Open your book (Kitabını aç).

10

Mert moves very fast between classrooms. The teacher wants him to walk safely. She says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) Don't run in the corridor

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert moves very fast between classrooms. The teacher wants him to walk safely.” Bu tarif “Don't run in the corridor” kelimesine uyar; Don't run in the corridor = Koridorda koşma. Diğer şıklar: Close the door (Kapıyı kapat), Don't shout (Bağırma), Don't be rude (Kaba olma).

11

Ece opens a sandwich during the lesson. Food belongs in the eating area at our school. The teacher says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Don't eat in the classroom

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece opens a sandwich during the lesson. Food belongs in the eating area at our school.” Bu tarif “Don't eat in the classroom” kelimesine uyar; Don't eat in the classroom = Sınıfta yemek yeme. Diğer şıklar: Open your book (Kitabını aç), Wear your uniform (Üniformanı giy), Be quiet (Sessiz ol).

12

Classes start at nine o'clock. Students need to arrive before the bell. The school rule says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) Don't be late

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Classes start at nine o'clock. Students need to arrive before the bell.” Bu tarif “Don't be late” kelimesine uyar; Don't be late = Geç kalma. Diğer şıklar: Don't run in the corridor (Koridorda koşma), Close the door (Kapıyı kapat), Obey the rules (Kurallara uy).

13

Ali speaks rudely to a new student. His teacher wants him to speak nicely and help others. She says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) Be kind

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali speaks rudely to a new student. His teacher wants him to speak nicely and help others.” Bu tarif “Be kind” kelimesine uyar; Be kind = Kibar ol. Diğer şıklar: Don't eat in the classroom (Sınıfta yemek yeme), Don't shout (Bağırma), Don't be rude (Kaba olma).

14

We collect used paper and plastic at school. We put them in special bins to make new things from them. We ______ these materials.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) recycle

Paragraftaki ipucu: “We collect used paper and plastic at school. We put them in special bins to make new things from them.” Bu tarif “recycle” kelimesine uyar; recycle = geri dönüştürmek. Diğer şıklar: obey (uymak), wear (giymek), protect (korumak).

15

The class waits outside before a lesson. We stand one behind another in a straight row. We ______ before entering.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) line up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “The class waits outside before a lesson. We stand one behind another in a straight row.” Bu tarif “line up” kelimesine uyar; line up = sıraya geçmek. Diğer şıklar: shout (bağırmak), fight (kavga etmek), chew gum (sakız çiğnemek).

16

We listen when our teachers speak. We speak politely to them and value their work. We ______ our teachers.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) respect

Paragraftaki ipucu: “We listen when our teachers speak. We speak politely to them and value their work.” Bu tarif “respect” kelimesine uyar; respect = saygı duymak. Diğer şıklar: recycle (geri dönüştürmek), obey (uymak), wear (giymek).

17

Sena reads a maths problem carefully. She thinks about the numbers and finds the answer. She can ______ the problem.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) solve

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena reads a maths problem carefully. She thinks about the numbers and finds the answer.” Bu tarif “solve” kelimesine uyar; solve = çözmek. Diğer şıklar: fight (kavga etmek), line up (sıraya geçmek), shout (bağırmak).

18

We keep animals safe in our garden. We stop people from hurting them. We ______ these animals.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) protect

Paragraftaki ipucu: “We keep animals safe in our garden. We stop people from hurting them.” Bu tarif “protect” kelimesine uyar; protect = korumak. Diğer şıklar: respect (saygı duymak), wear (giymek), obey (uymak).

19

Eren has a small piece of gum in his mouth. He moves his teeth but does not swallow it. He likes to ______ after school.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) chew gum

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren has a small piece of gum in his mouth. He moves his teeth but does not swallow it.” Bu tarif “chew gum” kelimesine uyar; chew gum = sakız çiğnemek. Diğer şıklar: solve (çözmek), line up (sıraya geçmek), recycle (geri dönüştürmek).

20

Our school has a celebration on 29 October. We carry Turkish flags and sing songs. We celebrate ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) Republic Day

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Our school has a celebration on 29 October. We carry Turkish flags and sing songs.” Bu tarif “Republic Day” kelimesine uyar; Republic Day = Cumhuriyet Bayramı. Diğer şıklar: Brazil (Brezilya), England (İngiltere), Scotland (İskoçya).

21

People celebrate a national victory on 30 August. Turkish flags decorate the streets. This special day is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Victory Day

Paragraftaki ipucu: “People celebrate a national victory on 30 August. Turkish flags decorate the streets.” Bu tarif “Victory Day” kelimesine uyar; Victory Day = Zafer Bayramı. Diğer şıklar: Eid al-Adha (Kurban Bayramı), Turkmenistan (Türkmenistan), Mexico (Meksika).

22

Our family celebrates at the end of Ramadan. We visit relatives and give sweets to children. This holiday is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) Eid al-Fitr

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Our family celebrates at the end of Ramadan. We visit relatives and give sweets to children.” Bu tarif “Eid al-Fitr” kelimesine uyar; Eid al-Fitr = Ramazan Bayramı. Diğer şıklar: Australia (Avustralya), Greece (Yunanistan), Spain (İspanya).

23

Berlin is a famous capital city. Elif's uncle lives there and speaks German. He lives in ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) Germany

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berlin is a famous capital city. Elif's uncle lives there and speaks German.” Bu tarif “Germany” kelimesine uyar; Germany = Almanya. Diğer şıklar: Azerbaijan (Azerbaycan), Uzbekistan (Özbekistan), Türkiye (Türkiye).

24

Tokyo is a large capital city. Arda's friend lives there and speaks Japanese. His country is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Japan

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tokyo is a large capital city. Arda's friend lives there and speaks Japanese.” Bu tarif “Japan” kelimesine uyar; Japan = Japonya. Diğer şıklar: France (Fransa), Thailand (Tayland), Italy (İtalya).

25

Madrid is the capital of this country. Duru's cousin lives there and speaks Spanish. The country is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) Spain

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Madrid is the capital of this country. Duru's cousin lives there and speaks Spanish.” Bu tarif “Spain” kelimesine uyar; Spain = İspanya. Diğer şıklar: Argentina (Arjantin), Singapore (Singapur), Russia (Rusya).

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

headmaster

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) okul müdürü

“headmaster” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “okul müdürü” olur. Bu ifade “Okul çalışanları” grubundandır. Örnek: The headmaster is in his office.

2

school nurse

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) okul hemşiresi

“school nurse” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “okul hemşiresi” olur. Bu ifade “Okul çalışanları” grubundandır. Örnek: The school nurse helps sick students.

3

cleaner

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) temizlik görevlisi

“cleaner” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “temizlik görevlisi” olur. Bu ifade “Okul çalışanları” grubundandır. Örnek: The cleaner cleans the classrooms.

4

coach

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) antrenör

“coach” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “antrenör” olur. Bu ifade “Okul çalışanları” grubundandır. Örnek: Our coach is very strict.

5

secretary

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) sekreter

“secretary” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “sekreter” olur. Bu ifade “Okul çalışanları” grubundandır. Örnek: The secretary works in the office.
